adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the updated `updateEvent` calendar selection logic is:

```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

The `.find(...)` branch only executes when `externalCalendarId` is falsy (e.g. `undefined`/`null`), but then it tries to match `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e. `=== undefined/null`), which will almost never match a real calendar externalId. That makes `selectedCalendar` `undefined` in the very case it is supposed to fall back to a destination calendar, likely causing updates (and similarly deletes; the same pattern appears in `deleteEvent`) to target the wrong calendar or fail depending on how `calendarId` is used downstream.
